name: mame
summary: [MAME](https://www.mamedev.org/) is a free and open-source emulator designed to emulate the hardware of arcade games, video game consoles, old computers and other systems in software on modern personal computers.

version.run: curl -s -L https://ppa.launchpadcontent.net/c.falco/mame/ubuntu/dists/resolute/main/binary-amd64/Packages.gz | gunzip |grep -A 7 -m 1 'Package: mame' | awk -F ': ' '/Version/{print $2;exit}' | awk -F'ubuntu' '{print $1}' | sed 's/+//g'

ports.description: HTTP MAME desktop gui, must be proxied.

volumes.description: Users home directory in the container, stores local files and settings
MAME directory containing artwork, roms, and assets.

custom.description: This is needed for MAME to function.

docs.setup:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:3001/

changelog.text: Make Wayland default disable with PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=false.
